Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11152 of 2022
Applicant :- Nanki @ Susheela Devi

Counsel for Applicant :- Upendra Kumar Verma,Adarsh Srivastava

Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Upendra Kumar Verma, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Akhilesh Kumar Vyas,
the learned A.G.A for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
156 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 Ipc, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District
Gonda.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 06.03.2022 against five persons, including the applicant, stating that the informant had entered into a registered agreement to purchase a property from the applicant on 20.04.2018 and the applicant had executed a sale deed in furtherance of the aforesaid agreement on 30.11.2021.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is 62 year's old innocent woman having no criminal history.
5. The learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at Bar that the applicant is languishing in jail since 05.05.2022 and even charges have not been framed till date.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid case.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
